title: [YouPass Collect] - Producing Electricity from Coal
prompt: The diagram below shows how one type of coal is used to produce electricity. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The given diagram illustrates the process by which electricity is produced from one type of coal.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the production of electricity from coal is a multi-stage process, beginning with the extraction of coal from a mine and culminating in the distribution of electricity to both commercial and residential buildings. Notably, waste heat is generated at two separate stages throughout the process.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: In the first stage, coal is extracted from an underground mine and transported to the surface in carts. It is then fed into a crusher, where it is broken down into smaller particles. The crushed coal is subsequently loaded onto trucks and delivered to a gasifier. At this facility, heat is applied to convert the coal into gas, which then moves to the next stage of the process.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the remaining steps, the gas first enters a cooling facility, during which waste heat is released. Following this, it passes through a cleaning facility to remove impurities and other contaminants from the gas. The purified gas is subsequently fed into a gas power plant, where it is used to generate electricity, with additional waste heat being produced as a result. Finally, the electricity is transmitted via power lines to supply both commercial buildings and residential homes in urban areas.
